Definition: an action (good or bad); generally, a transaction; abstractly, activity; by implication, a product (specifically, a poem) or (generally) property
BiblicalUsage: 1) deed, work; 1a) deed, thing done, act; 1b) work, labour; 1c) business, pursuit; 1d) undertaking, enterprise; 1e) achievement; 1f) deeds, works (of deliverance and judgment); 1g) work, thing made; 1h) work (of God); 1i) product
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
